ag.stopTitle: Pull the plug on every agent?
ag.stopMsg: Every agent of yours gets paused, waiting requests get a no and anything running gets cut. Resume them one by one later.
ag.stopMsgAdmin: Every agent on this server gets paused, waiting requests get a no, anything running gets cut and NoCap MCP goes off.
ag.stopped: Done: {paused} paused, {denied} requests denied, {stopped} runs cut
ag.revokeMsg: Its token dies right away. Add it again whenever.
ag.heroTitle: Let your AI agents use this server
ag.heroHint: Agents that speak MCP get NoCapOS’s tools, only the ones you allow. Looking around is instant;
ag.accessAdminOnly: Only an admin can flip these.
ag.letInOn: On — agents with a token can connect.
ag.letInOff: Off — every agent token is ignored.
ag.loopbackOn: Agents on other devices can’t connect, even with a token.
ag.loopbackOff: Agents added as “other devices” can connect over the network. Keep tokens secret, fr.
ag.assistantHint: What the built-in AI Assistant can do for you. All off until you say so.
ag.assistantOff: No access yet — it can only chat
ag.yoursHint: Every agent gets its own vibe check: what it can touch, where from, until when.
ag.none: No agents yet — hit Add an agent to make one.
ag.kindLocalHint: Runs on this server. Can’t connect from anywhere else.
ag.kindRemoteHint: Runs on another computer on your network. Lock it to its address below.
ag.kindRemoteBlocked: Runs on another computer. Blocked until an admin turns off “Only agents on this machine”.
ag.rotateMsg: Its current token dies right away.
ag.pauseHint: Block it for now, keep its setup.
ag.name: Name
ag.ipAllowHint: IPs or ranges, comma-separated. Empty = any address.
ag.noTools: Its access doesn’t unlock any tools.
ag.askAgain: Ask me again for this one
ag.preset.monitoring.hint: Logs, system, network and containers, read-only.
ag.preset.files_photos.hint: Reads and changes files and photos, asking first.
ag.preset.admin.hint: Almost everything, every change asks first.
ag.preset.full.hint: Everything, mostly no asking. Only for agents you’d trust with your life.
ag.cap.files.hint: Your files, within the folders below.
ag.cap.photos.hint: The Photos library: list, favorite, delete.
ag.cap.system.hint: System info and storage; change renames the server.
ag.cap.network.hint: Adapters and Wi-Fi; change joins or leaves networks.
ag.cap.users.hint: Who can sign in; manage disables and enables people.
ag.cap.screen.hint: Screenshots of NoCap Desktop; control types, clicks and opens pages.
ag.cap.apps.hint: App Store apps; manage installs, starts and stops them.
ag.cap.terminal.hint: Runs shell commands as your own Linux account (never root).
ag.cap.code.hint: Python, Node or shell snippets: in a sealed sandbox, or on this server as you.
ag.cap.power.hint: Restarts or shuts down the server. Always asks first.
ag.foldersAll: Every location you can open. Add folders to fence it in.
ag.foldersHint: File and photo tools only work inside these.
ag.folderBad: Write a folder as location:/path, like data:/Documents
ag.activityHint: Everything your agents asked for, newest first.
ag.setupHint: Paste one of these into your agent’s MCP settings, with your token in place of the placeholder.
ag.snipCommandHint: For agents on this machine: they start cap mcp, which talks to NoCapOS locally.
ag.snipHttpHint: Streamable HTTP at {url} with your token as a bearer header (older apps: {sse}).
ag.usePairing: Pair with a one-time code (no token copy-pasting)
ag.codeIntro: Use it on the agent’s computer within 10 minutes. One use only, then it turns into the agent’s token.
ag.tokenIntro: Copy it now — it’s shown this once and NoCapOS only keeps a scrambled copy.
ag.pairCmdHint: Run this on the agent’s computer, then use cap mcp as its MCP command. Other apps can POST the code to {url}.
ag.snipYamlHint: For agents configured with YAML: add this to their MCP servers, then restart the agent.
